title: ConsoleUninstallService
responsibility: Removes an installed console from a host, puts back what the install replaced, and never removes edited files unasked.

inputs.name: ConsoleUninstallService.uninstall.options
inputs.description: Options identify the host project directory and control how generated files edited since installation are handled. The optional update and keep fields default to undefined; keep leaves edited files in place even when update is also true, while neither flag causes edited files to be refused.

outputs.name: ConsoleUninstallService.uninstall
outputs.description: The resolved result identifies the host and lists generated file paths removed, restored to their pre-install content, or left in place as host-owned; changes lists the changes recorded during this uninstall. clean is true when no host-owned file entries or changes remain, in which case the manifest is removed.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the host has no harness-owned console files, or when files edited since installation are found and neither update nor keep permits proceeding. With update, the edited file content is saved and recorded before removal; with keep, those files remain as host-owned.
